scope_note: Algeria confirmed Yango market. Its marquee water network is the Bay of Algiers -- a wide bay ringed by marinas and ports that today connect only by a congested coast road. Oran, Bejaia and Mostaganem are separate coastal anchors too far apart (>>70 nm) to chain to Algiers; deepen the Algiers bay and lightly deepen Oran's own gulf; leave the far anchors honest-thin.
no_invention_rule: Every BP is a real named marina/port with a source URL. Grok does deterministic ID-match, coords, and seal.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Port de Sidi Fredj (marina)
boarding_point_candidates.note: 450-berth marina on the Sidi Fredj peninsula ~30 km west of Algiers (Staoueli); one of the finest marinas on the Mediterranean south shore.

boarding_point_candidates.name: El Djamila / Ain Benian marina
boarding_point_candidates.note: Coastal port and marina at Ain Benian, between Sidi Fredj and Algiers.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Port d'Alger (city waterfront)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Central Algiers port on the bay; existing anchor.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Tamentfoust (east bay harbour)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Fishing harbour on the eastern Bay of Algiers below the Roman ruins of Rusguniae, near Cap Matifou.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Round the Sidi Fredj peninsula offshore before the coastal run east; do not cut across the headland.

corridors.desc: coastal run into the city port
corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Coastal hop east into the Bay of Algiers; offshore waypoint to clear the Ain Benian shoal.

corridors.desc: cross-bay hop to the east shore
corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Cross the Bay of Algiers to the east side and round Cap Matifou headland offshore into Tamentfoust.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Port d'Oran (waterfront)
boarding_point_candidates.note: Main Oran port on the Gulf of Oran; existing anchor.

boarding_point_candidates.name: Ain El Turck / Kristel waterfront
boarding_point_candidates.note: Resort waterfront on the Gulf of Oran west of the city.

corridors.hand_waypoint_note: Coastal run within the Gulf of Oran; offshore waypoint to clear the Mers-el-Kebir headland.

honest_thin_anchors.note: Bejaia marina/port on the Gulf of Bejaia -- real anchor but ~100 nm east of Algiers; keep as single-node coastal anchor, no long corridor to Algiers.
Mostaganem marina on its own gulf ~50 nm ENE of Oran -- keep as single-node coastal anchor.

excluded_context_only.reason: >>70 nm along the coast; out of N30 range. Separate local clusters, never one national corridor.
